state.name: year.leading

state.name: bark.integrity

state.name: sap
state.description: Sacred water, the main resource.

state.name: food
state.description: Food stores; each season the city eats hands / 2.

state.name: flake_stock
state.description: Bark flake, a building material gathered by idle builders.

state.name: hands
state.description: The city's working population (cap 60).

state.name: councils

state.name: forecasts_made

state.name: forecasts_correct
state.description: Tremor forecasts with the right day-part and face.

state.name: tread_forecast
state.description: The player forecast the next seventh-day tread in c6_scroll: +1 card at the Shadow.

state.name: temples_opened
state.description: Ring Doors opened.

state.name: heartwood_opened
state.description: The Heartwood Door was opened (integrity -8).

state.name: recipes_found
state.description: Recipes found in the Sap Kitchen (of 12).

state.name: offerings
state.description: Offering pots cooked.

state.name: great_offering
state.description: The Great Offering was made in c6_offering.

state.name: tns.wins
state.description: Trunk and Shadow festivals won.

state.name: tns_rules
state.description: Rule cards added to Trunk and Shadow.

state.name: shadow_rehearsed
state.description: The winter festival was won: +1 card at the Shadow.

state.name: beetle_reading
state.description: How the Beetle was read.

state.name: ant_reading
state.description: How the ants were read (from the leaf spread's policy).

state.name: prophecy.suit
state.description: The Crown suit of the birdsong reading: the prophecy.

state.name: expedition.heard
state.description: The expedition reached the Listening Knot and heard the song.

state.name: defence.breaches
state.description: Crack defences breached.

state.name: fallen
state.description: Bark people lost this year.

state.name: roll
state.description: The Roll of the Bark: everyone lost, with one habit each.

state.name: burr.wounded
state.description: Captain Burr was wounded (the Beetle fought and breached, or the war).

state.name: mossa.on_time
state.description: Crack runs Mossa finished inside the limit.

state.name: mossa.shadow_late
state.description: Mossa reached the cities after the dark in c6_run: -1 card at the Shadow.

state.name: pell.alive
state.description: Elder Pell lives until his last spread.

state.name: pell.heir
state.description: Who inherits Pell's deck.

state.name: twig.kite_freed
state.description: The player freed Twig's kite at dawn.

state.name: pullbacks
state.description: Times the player looked up to the backyard.

state.name: edge_map
state.description: Fenn drew the map with an edge (habit branch).

state.name: pulse.heard
state.description: The Pulse woke Highridge and the night spread was laid (c4_omen_pulse, a scene to add). Accepted 2026-11-15, phase 1.

state.name: pulse.blank_turned
state.description: The player turned the Backyard card on the night of the Pulse and found it blank.

state.name: pulse.answer
state.description: Who answers the Pulse, from the night spread's policy: the Knot keeps it holy and unread, the Battlements stand a watch, the Scroll House records it, or all three.

state.name: faceless_marks
state.description: Faceless marks the player placed rightly on the Tremor Scroll (c4_scroll). Each shades one plate of the Pulse map.

state.name: pulse_map.complete
state.description: Every faceless mark of the year was placed rightly, so the Pulse map shows the plate the second tap will find.

state.name: deck.honest
state.description: Pell is dead and the heir deals: no card of the event's suit is guaranteed, and each heir deals in character.

state.name: pulse
state.description: Hidden. How loud the Trunk's Pulse is. Tap tokens beyond 3, Knot Sanctums and offering pots raise it; frost, the ants' procession (−15), each Gallery Plug pot (−8) and sealing the Heartwood (−10) lower it. Shown only as marks on the faceless row.

state.name: sorrel.met
state.description: Sorrel's Wall was played: at the end of the spring run she put Mossa's ear to a wall.

state.name: sorrel.backed
state.description: One autumn council token went to Sorrel's listeners. If true, the lowest street of Lowridge was empty when it settled.

state.name: pell.thumb_seen
state.description: The Thumb on the Deck was played: the player saw Pell deal by the notches. Opens notch-reading (once a spread).

state.name: fenn.second_scroll
state.description: The Faceless Marks was played: Fenn showed the player the scroll the Scroll House forbids.

state.name: lowridge.settled
state.description: Lowridge Comes Up the Crack has happened: the lowest street settled into a gallery and Lowridge climbed to Highridge.

state.name: gallery_plug.site
state.description: Where the Gallery Plug pots were poured. That site's paper floors are solid in the next Crack runner.

state.name: gallery_plug.pots
state.description: Gallery Plug pots cooked in The Great Mending. Each is pulse −8.

state.name: door.scars
state.description: Scars left on the last Ring Door (moves over par, at most 2 counted). Each is an extra side entrance in the next Crack defence.

state.name: door.clean_cuts
state.description: Ring Doors opened at or under par. Each is one more knot shelter in c6_shadow.

state.name: heartwood.state
state.description: The Heartwood Door: never opened, standing open, or opened and sealed again (pulse −10, the Knot −4).

state.name: ants.escorted
state.description: The autumn ants were read as gods and brought to the paper wall: the procession opened it (pulse −15).

state.name: shadow.played
state.description: The player won winter's Trunk and Shadow from Twig's side, as the Shadow. In c6_touch the three tap sites show ten seconds early.

state.name: sounding.heard
state.description: The Sounding was played in c6_touch: each of the three taps answered by a plate.

state.name: playthroughs
state.description: Finished runs (written at the end of c7_backyard). From the second playthrough: the notches are readable from the first deal, the faceless row is on the scroll from chapter 1, the stump shows over the fence in the first pull-back, Sorrel can be a festival opponent, and Resin's thirteenth page shows its word from spring.
